# Week Cluster

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The set of structured notes and artifacts generated for a single week, aggregating and analyzing its constituent Day Clusters.

## Scope note

Sits above DayCluster and below Month in the Calendar hierarchy; narrower concepts include WeekIndex, WeekAnalysis, WeekMealPlan, WeekDiabetes, and WeekHealth.
